tools.name: feasibility
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what they can build on a plot or piece of land in Maharashtra, wherever UDCPR 2020 applies (outside Greater Mumbai and the other areas regulation 1.1(i) leaves out; towns says which): FSI or FAR, built-up area, setbacks (margins), height, how many floors, parking or approv

tools.name: compare_uses
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to know which uses are allowed on a plot in Maharashtra, or how built-up differs between uses on the same land. Returns every use on the same land in a fixed order: allowed or the reason not, conditions, clause, and built-up with and without TDR.

tools.name: check_design
tools.description: Use this when someone has a proposed building on a plot in Maharashtra and wants to know whether it meets UDCPR. Checks a proposal's built-up, height and margins (one per side, in side order) against UDCPR, with allowed, proposed and pass or fail per item. Margins need the height or the upper floors

tools.name: clause
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what a specific UDCPR regulation or table says. Returns the UDCPR text of a regulation or table by its number, such as '6.2.6', '11.2.4' or 'Table 6-G'.

tools.name: search_udcpr
tools.description: Use this when someone asks where UDCPR deals with a topic, such as refuge areas or rainwater harvesting. Returns lines of UDCPR that contain all the given words, with their chapter; a regulation's own heading first.

tools.name: towns
tools.description: Use this when the town or planning authority of a plot is unclear or spelt differently. Returns Maharashtra towns and authorities with their kind and class; every one when no query is given.

tools.name: draw_plot
tools.description: Use this when a plot's shape is given as measurements rather than as one area: side lengths with the angles at the corners, or with diagonals, or both, as on a hand-drawn sketch, a measurement sheet, a survey or a photo of any of them; or the corners themselves. Read the figures as written (feet and

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this to find UDCPR regulations and tables, a town's page, or what a term means, on any topic: refuge area, marginal distance on a 12 m road, Table 6-G, parking for flats, Kolhapur, what carpet area or TDR is. Returns results, each with an id to pass to fetch, a title and a url to cite.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this to read one result of search in full: a UDCPR regulation or table in its own words as notified, what a town is under UDCPR with the figures for a common plot there, or a term in plain language with UDCPR's own definition. Returns id, title, text, url to cite, and metadata.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "feasibility" is 1532 chars, far longer than this server's median (282). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
